snippet.title: Live Playthrough (04.05.2023) - Memories Off (PSP, No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Is it possible to play a visual novel using Google Translate? Yes, but oh boy it's tough!

Next time, I will try to record my own smartphone so it makes a little more sense why I take so long from one scene to another. Overall, I think I was able to understand about 30% of everything said so far, thanks to the translator. Of course, it's better than 0%.

From my understanding, Yue is a bit airheaded, so you can tell her any absurd story like taking care of sea turtles for the next classroom, and she will buy it. But she was pretty good at hide and seek, and may happen to fell asleep while waiting for others to find her. By the way, her name is translated as "laughter" for some reason.

Ayaka was the first girl introduced but we don't know a lot about her, yet. I like her voice, though. I wonder what is so angelic about her, given the original (PS1) cover of the game. It's one of the best illustrations I have seen as cover art for a game.
